description: This file is a Zephyr driver source file for GD32 microcontroller pin configuration, including initialization, pin setup, and remap configuration.

methods.name: afio_init
methods.description: Initializes AFIO by enabling its clock and configuring I/O compensation if enabled in Devicetree.

methods.name: configure_spd
methods.description: Configures the speed register for a GPIO port based on the specified speed.

methods.name: configure_pin
methods.description: Configures a specific pin based on its configuration parameters.

methods.name: configure_remap
methods.description: Configures the remap settings based on the provided remap bitfield.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pins
methods.description: Configures multiple pins according to the provided pin configuration array.
